terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms outline how you can use Ouiboo to plan and book your adventures.
terms.sectionOneBody: Create a profile, discover trips, and book experiences in a respectful way.
terms.sectionTwoBody: Keep your login details safe and let us know if you notice unusual activity.
terms.sectionThreeBody: Review trip policies before booking and contact support if plans change.
terms.sectionFourBody: We are here to help via in-app chat and email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We use your data to personalize trips, manage bookings, and improve Ouiboo.
privacy.highlightOne: We only collect data needed to deliver your travel experience.
privacy.highlightTwo: You control marketing preferences in your profile.
privacy.highlightThree: We protect sensitive data with encryption and secure access.
privacy.highlightFour: You can request data deletion at any time.
privacy.contactBody: Reach out to privacy@ouiboo.com and we'll respond quickly.
